newsitem.title: FRANCE: Morocco re-tenders for 90,000 tonnes wheat.
newsitem.headline: Morocco re-tenders for 90,000 tonnes wheat.

text.p: Morocco, which earlier postponed a tender for up to 130,000 tonnes of soft wheat, re-entered the grain market on Tuesday with a tender to import 90,000 tonnes, European grain traders said.
Shipment dates were not immediately confirmed but one trade report said they were for early September.
Results of the tender are due on August 12, traders said.
Morocco had tendered for 130,000 tonnes of both August and September wheat on Monday, but postponed the tender overnight citing high prices.
European grain traders, who put the size of the original tender at 120,000 tonnes, said it had included August shipments of 30,000 tonnes.
This appeared to leave 90,000 tonnes for September, which matched the amount sought in the new tender, they said.
It was not immediately clear whether Morocco planned to re-tender for any further wheat purchases for August.
